channel.title: The Finance Briefing
channel.description: Your President's Daily Brief for markets, twice a day. Every @KobeissiLetter post with charts fully explained, Adam Kobeissi's analysis, the day's biggest finance and economics headlines — the Fed, rates, and everything moving the stock market — consolidated by topic, not by tweet. Morning briefings cover 4:30 PM–7 AM Eastern, afternoons cover 7 AM–4:30 PM.
channel.itunes:author: Carl Meiselman

item.description: Afternoon briefing of the day's finance news (7 AM to 4:30 PM Eastern, September 21, 2026): every @KobeissiLetter markets post with charts described, plus the biggest finance, Fed, and markets headlines, consolidated by topic.
